## 3. DATA MODEL FOR FRAGMENT TITLE AND TAG PATH

### Fragment Class
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/fragment.js`
  - **Line 3**: Fragment class definition
  - **Lines 4-12**: Core properties:
    - `path` - Full AEM path to fragment
    - `id` - Fragment UUID
    - `title` - Display title (stored in AEM as fragment title metadata)
    - `name` - Fragment name (last part of path)
    - `fields` - Array of field objects
    - `tags` - Array of tag objects
    - `model` - Object with `id` and `path`
    - `status` - Draft/Published status
    - `etag` - For optimistic locking

### Tag Data Structure
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem-tag-picker-field.js`
  - **Lines 15-29**: `fromAttribute()` converts tag format:

    - To: `"/content/cq:tags/mas/product/photoshop"` (path)
  - **Lines 35-46**: `toAttribute()` converts back
  - Tags stored with both `id` (e.g., `"mas:product/photoshop"`) and `path` (full AEM path)

### Fragment Creation Payload Structure

## 4. UNIQUENESS AND VALIDATION CHECKS

### Fragment Name Deduplication
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem.js`
  - **Lines 647-672**: `generateUniqueName(basePath, assetName)` method
    - Checks if name already exists in target folder
    - Appends numeric suffix if conflict: `base-1`, `base-2`, etc.
    - Respects file extensions if present
    - Max 100 attempts before throwing error

### Creation Retry Logic with Suffix
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js`
  - **Lines 186-195**: `getSuffix(offset)` - Generates random alphanumeric suffix
  - **Lines 231-236**: Retry loop when fragment creation fails:
    - Tries with original name first
    - On failure, appends random suffix: `name-abc123`
    - Retries up to 10 times

### Grouped Variation Name Deduplication
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-repository.js`
  - **Lines 1556-1562**: Creates grouped variation with name conflict handling
    - Generates 4-character random suffix if name exists
    - Format: `fragmentName-abcd`

### Title Validation During Clone
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
  - **Lines 1105-1110**: `confirmClone()` validation:
    - For merch-card model: requires either OSI or existing OSI
    - Title is optional (can use existing title)
    - No explicit title uniqueness check (relies on fragment name uniqueness)

### Tag Path Structure
- Tags use full path format: `/content/cq:tags/namespace/category/value`
- Example: `/content/cq:tags/mas/product/photoshop`
- Can be converted to attribute format: `mas:product/photoshop`
- No built-in uniqueness validation at the tag picker level
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/mas-filter-panel.js`
  - **Lines 93-109**: Converts tag paths to tag IDs and filters
